messages:
jen_partnerships: Kicking off a short playbook for model data provenance for open-weight partners. Goal: make onboarding checks straightforward and automatable. :white_check_mark:
liam_legal: Quick note — we need to capture license + dataset provenance + a named contact. Also flag any export-control or embargoed-source concerns asap.
maria_pm: high level ask: what's the minimum acceptance criteria we show to partners so they don't get blocked?
liam_legal: Minimum (short):
```
- model_license: SPDX or clear equivalent
- dataset_manifest: list of sources + licenses
- dataset_attribution: authors/origin contact
- cryptographic_hashes: SHA256 for weight blobs
- provenance_statement: PGP-signed or signed PDF with timestamp
- export_control_flag: yes/no w/notes
```
sam_ops: From infra side, we should also require a machine-readable model card (yaml/json) with topology, tokenizer, and expected input/output shapes. We'll add a lightweight verification script so Dedicated/private deploys can run preflight.
aj_devrel: We should surface a small badge in Console + Marketplace like `provenance-verified` and a collapsible "Provenance" panel that shows the manifest and contact. Keep the public-facing info minimal to avoid leaking infra details. :bulb:
supplychain-bot: Scan result for sample model `openflux-13b-v1`: missing `dataset_manifest` and unsigned `provenance_statement`. See logs: https://ci.internal/redwood/supplychain/scan/9876
jen_partnerships: OK assigned owners: liam -> template + legal text, sam -> verification scripts + infra hooks, aj -> console badges + UX copy, maria -> partner-facing checklist and outreach. Target: POC checklist by EOW (Fri).
maria_pm: can we make one-page checklist that partners can paste into PRs/attachments? Short checklist items, 5-7 lines.
liam_legal: I'll draft the checklist. For partners that can't provide PGP signing we can accept notarized attestations for the first 90 days but must escalate to full signature before GA.
sam_ops: verification command prototype: `./tools/verify_provenance.sh --model-dir /tmp/model --manifest manifest.yaml` returns exit code 0/1 and produces `provenance-report.json`. We'll iterate on schema.
aj_devrel: sample manifest snippet to include in partner docs:
```json
{
  "model_name": "openflux-13b-v1",
  "weights_sha256": "<sha256>",
  "datasets": [
    {"name": "CommonCrawlSubset", "license": "CC-BY-4.0", "source_url": "https://..."}
  ],
  "contact": "legal@example.com"
}
```
jen_partnerships: Great. Next steps: liam + sam pair up on the verification schema, aj will add badge spec, maria will draft the partner email + checklist. Quick sync Wed 10am to lock scope. :calendar:
liam_legal: :thumbsup: adding export-control decision tree to the checklist (short).
maria_pm: I'll prep the outreach template and include fallback flow for partners that need time.
jen_partnerships: Thanks team — moving task to channel checklist thread and pinging partner leads. If anyone sees edge cases (PGP not available, third-party escrow), flag here. :eyes:
